> Protocol. A recurring way work moves, a decision gets made, or data is found and trusted. Protocols run between people, software and machines: handoffs, checklists, approvals, APIs, permissions, alarms.

Here is the definition I committed to memory was rules, steps or procedures for reliably coordinating action.

What also about non machine and non human protocols? Say between ants or whales, fungi and trees.
